name: Flummy
summary:
Move the mouse to aim, hold Space to charge a jump and release it to peform it!

(If you are on mobile, press the left arrow first and change the Spacebar Setting to the mouse setting!)

Avoid all of the dangerous obstacles on top of a digitally hand-drawn piece of paper! (More of a skill issue than an artstyle)

Collect the coins spawning around the battlefield every few seconds! Using them, you can buy a variaty of cool skins for your Flummy - that will also function as an additional live each!
Or do you want to make it even EASIER? Just click on the arrow next to the big "Start" button and buy some useful hats! Each cost nine coins - which is the maximum amount you can carry! So think well before spending your entire money!
